measurement_limits: Parent CPU and RSS exclude PostgreSQL and external services
Child CPU/RSS include collector children, not concurrent full-stack memory
Controlled loopback latency does not establish live source throughput
Drain deadlines are checked between bounded collector calls
Queue samples retain the latest 1000 samples; maxima cover every sample
Spool usage covers the configured directory, not child anonymous temporary files
Compaction active files exclude older objects retained for lineage
Session RSS is sampled at 250 ms; brief peaks may be missed
Missing /proc children: aggregate RSS unavailable; discovered RSS is a lower bound
Supervisor CPU/RSS includes Moto; worker CPU includes the controlled source
PostgreSQL/Dagster/dashboard and other host processes are excluded from RSS/CPU
Logical observation timestamps do not measure live upstream freshness
Schema/files exclude PostgreSQL WAL, temp files and container disk
namespace_isolation: empty synthetic workspace and global verification inputs required; no concurrent workload

published_data.scope: Unique objects referenced by committed manifests; excludes manifests/derived objects
